title: PhET: Research
read_depth: Primary programme page: design rationale, interview procedure, research questions and limitations of simulations
supports: Inquiry-oriented controls and iterative learner evaluation
adaptation: One prediction prompt and a small purposeful control set per analytic demonstration
limitation: Our prototype has not undergone PhET's learner interview process; no equivalent educational outcome claim

title: Observable Plot: Accessibility
read_depth: Full accessibility feature section, root SVG and per-mark ARIA options
supports: Accessible descriptions at plot and mark level, hiding redundant decoration
adaptation: Add named plot descriptions, units, line styles and data-table alternatives to existing SVG plots
limitation: ARIA attributes alone do not establish WCAG conformance; no Observable Plot library installation requested

title: Jupyter Book: Execute & Compute
read_depth: Full current overview: build-time execution, caching, output reuse, interactive widgets and remote-kernel distinction
supports: Separating executed output, cached output and live execution capabilities
adaptation: Recorded-result badges, provenance and exact raw-data downloads; explicitly separate browser analytic calculations
limitation: The Observatory is a static research frontend; no remote Jupyter kernel or hosted notebook service is implemented

title: ARIA Authoring Practices: Dialog (Modal) Pattern
read_depth: Keyboard interaction, initial focus for structured content, focus restoration and dialog labeling
supports: Requested modal behavior, Escape, contained tab sequence, initial and restored focus
adaptation: One evidence dialog opened explicitly by the user, with visible close and focus restoration
limitation: Implementation must be exercised in browser; this spec does not claim a completed accessibility audit
